news.title: FDIC Proposes Limited Brokered-Deposit Exception for Small Banks
news.body: The FDIC proposed allowing certain banks with less than $10 billion in assets to exclude qualifying custodial deposits from brokered-deposit treatment, capped at 20% of total liabilities. PYMNTS reports that compensation for placing deposits would disqualify those deposits, while separately paid recordkeeping services could remain compatible. The distinction makes placement fees and service arrangements material to bank-fintech contracts; the proposal does not create a blanket fintech-deposit exception. Comments would remain open for 60 days following Federal Register publication.

news.title: Alipay+ Connects Overseas Wallets to Brazil’s Pix QR Codes
news.body: Visitors using supported Alipay+ payment apps can scan Pix QR codes in Brazil without downloading another app, Ant International announced. The integration connects participating international wallets to domestic QR acceptance, adding a payment route for travelers and Pix-accepting merchants. The announcement did not provide corridor-level pricing or measured card substitution. Alipay+’s global merchant and account totals describe its broader network, not adoption of the Brazil connection.

news.title: Payhawk Raises $280 Million at a $2 Billion Valuation
news.body: TechCrunch reports that Payhawk raised $280 million in Series C funding at a $2 billion valuation, bringing total funding above $515 million. Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives led the round, and managing director James Hayward is joining the board. Payhawk says the proceeds will support finance workflows combining AI agents, payments infrastructure and enterprise approval controls, extending its scope across procurement, accounts payable and expenses. The announcement describes planned expansion, not measured improvements in payment economics.

news.title: Four New Zealand Banks Join BioCatch Fraud-Intelligence Network
news.body: ANZ New Zealand, ASB, BNZ and Westpac NZ joined BioCatch Trust New Zealand, which will share receiving-account risk intelligence with sending banks before funds move. BioCatch says the network will take several months to become operational. Its design adds cross-bank behavioral and device signals to existing fraud checks, giving participating banks more information for transfer-intervention decisions. The announcement does not establish live nationwide coverage, and New Zealand fraud-reduction results are not yet available.

news.title: Vendor Breaches Expose Customer Information at Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan
news.body: The Wall Street Journal reported that attackers leaked information belonging to thousands of customers through third-party service providers. Visa said card numbers and its own systems were unaffected. Mastercard described limited information from a specific benefits program and no network disruption. JPMorgan described marketing information potentially including names and emails, separating the incident from its earlier service disruption. Those disclosures distinguish third-party customer-data exposure from a payment-processing outage and identify different notification scopes for the three companies.

perspective: The FDIC’s custodial-deposit proposal and Alipay+’s Pix connection lead today’s developments in deposit eligibility, cross-border acceptance, finance software and customer protection.
